error_message: Sprite spawn used an unmoduloed segment index past the track length and killed the game loop
root_cause: Segment lookup indexed segments[] directly without wrapping by track length
prevention_rule: All segment access goes through findSeg(), which wraps by track length

error_message: Attract-mode demo steering pulled the car the wrong way (sign error)
root_cause: Centrifugal compensation was applied with a flipped sign in demo mode
prevention_rule: Centrifugal drift is always subtracted from playerX; headless test asserts curve holdability

error_message: Traffic advanced twice per frame, making cars double-fast
root_cause: updateTraffic(dt) was invoked from two call sites in the frame loop
prevention_rule: updateTraffic has exactly one call site, asserted by headless test

error_message: Fire input silently did nothing: races started with no weapon, weapons only came from unmarked random crates, and dry fire had zero feedback
root_cause: reset() left weapon=null; fireWeapon() returned early with no message/sound/HUD change; specs blessed the silence (sr-cw-dry-fire)
prevention_rule: Races start armed (default blaster, unlimited ammo); finite weapons revert to blaster; trusted-input E2E fires within the first second

error_message: Touch slide-steering never transferred zones: a finger sliding from left zone to right zone kept steering left
root_cause: pointermove recomputed the role from e.target, but touch pointers are implicitly captured to the pointerdown target so the target never changes
prevention_rule: Non-fire pointers resolve their role from clientX on every move; fire-pad pointers stay fire for their lifetime; E2E slides a real touch across zones

error_message: CI gates workflow failed on main since the Overdrive merge while the merge report claimed gates passed
root_cause: semantic-scan needs the typescript compiler API, installed locally but never in ci.yml; regression_check --all also lacked a tag/HEAD~20 diff base
prevention_rule: CI installs typescript@5 before semantic scan; releases are tagged so --all has a base; PR merge requires a green run

error_message: Downloaded export from the game-over screen booted into a stale GAME OVER screen
root_cause: downloadSelf serialized live documentElement.outerHTML including runtime class flips
prevention_rule: Export serializes a normalized clone (title visible, game-over/HUD hidden); E2E asserts the exported markup

error_message: Determinism was frame-rate coupled: render() consumed the gameplay RNG stream, so replays diverged by frame count
root_cause: speed lines, shake, muzzle flash, nitro flames, weather, particles, and audio noise all drew from the gameplay-seeded rng()
prevention_rule: Two seeded streams: rng for gameplay, vrng for purely visual consumers; unit test interleaves renderOnce between ticks

title: Road leaves viewport off-road (double camera/sprite displacement)
symptom: User: game still goes off the screen
root_cause: Camera tracked playerX*ROAD_W fully while the car sprite added a playerX*0.28W offset; road band pixel-verified absent on all phone viewports at steering extremes
fix: Camera tracks playerX with camXFor cap past the road edge; car sprite always screen-centered; soft wall at |playerX|>1.6
regression_pattern: Playwright mobility matrix road-band pixel assertions (tests/mobility/mobility.mjs)

title: Brake visually mute + brake input zone wider than its visible strip
symptom: User: the break perhaps breakd the visuals
root_cause: No brake lights/skids; #tz-brake covered 32-54% while zoneForX mapped 32-68%
fix: Brake lights + progressive decel + screech + skid system; brake strip widened to 36% (32-68%)
regression_pattern: mobility matrix brakeGlow pixel assertion + brake-strip rect coverage assertion

title: Player car hidden under fire pad in landscape at right lock
symptom: Car sprite overlaps FIRE pad rect
root_cause: Sprite offset 0.28W*playerX placed the car under the fixed pad
fix: Car always screen-centered; matrix asserts zero car/pad rect overlap

title: Near-camera props scale without bound
symptom: Giant palms cover half the landscape screen
root_cause: drawProp size clamp H*0.6 with no near fade
fix: size cap min(H,W)*0.35 + alpha fade within 3 segments of camera
